notes.title: Controller Remapping patch
notes.content: A few buttons were using an old input management system. You are now able to map your controls to the button you want and everything should work as expected in game.

tags.feature: You are now able to map your controls to the button you want and everything should work as expected in game.

notes.title: Bug Fix
notes.content:
- Fixed typos.
- Update text in game.
- Updated the sprites for some world objects making them stand out from the backgrounds.
- added another health porkchop.
- Save station now fills health to full.
- Added more grace room to Aether boosts. this should make it a little easier to complete combos.
- Various other bugs fixed.
